title: "Overview and notation"

## Entry points

| entry point | problem | numerical core | article |
|:------------|:--------|:---------------|:--------|
| `cppODE()`  | ODE $\dot x = f(x, p, t)$ | in-tree integrator, `inst/include/cppde/` | [Stepping](methods-stepping.html) to [Second derivatives](methods-forward-reverse.html) |
| `cvode()`   | ODE $\dot x = f(x, p, t)$ | SUNDIALS CVODE/CVODES | [cvode() and the CVODES adjoint](methods-cvode.html) |
| `cppFUN()`  | algebraic $y = g(x, p)$ | none | [Derivative directions of cppFUN()](methods-cppfun.html) |
| `ptc()`     | steady state $f(x, p) = 0$, $C x = b$ | pseudo-transient continuation on a `cppFUN()` object | [Steady states by pseudo-transient continuation](methods-ptc.html) |

Table: Entry points. The first three share the
[code generator](methods-codegen.html).

`cppODE()` and `cvode()` take the same model arguments (`rhs`, `events`,
`rootfunc`, `fixed`, `forcings`) and return the same object for
`solveODE()` ([comparison](methods-cvode.html#comparison)). `cppFUN()`
derivatives are `"forward"` (second order with `deriv2 = TRUE`),
`"reverse"` or `"forward-reverse"`.

## Order of the articles

1. [Code generation](methods-codegen.html): expression graph and emitted
   C++ of all entry points.
2. [Stepping and error control](methods-stepping.html): the four methods of
   `cppODE()`, error control, dense output.
3. [Forward sensitivities](methods-forward.html): dual numbers.
4. [Events, switches and saltation](methods-events.html): sensitivities
   across resets, root events and switches.
5. [Reverse mode: the discrete adjoint](methods-reverse.html): gradients at
   a cost independent of the parameter count.
6. [Events in reverse mode](methods-reverse-events.html): adjoint of a
   jump, to second order.
7. [Grid and refinement of the sweep](methods-reverse-checks.html): the
   adjoint grid and `refine`.
8. [Second derivatives: forward over reverse](methods-forward-reverse.html):
   Hessian-vector products.
9. [cvode() and the CVODES adjoint](methods-cvode.html): the SUNDIALS
   backend.
10. [Derivative directions of cppFUN()](methods-cppfun.html): observation
    maps and reparametrizations.
11. [Steady states by pseudo-transient continuation](methods-ptc.html):
    `ptc()` under conservation laws, stability test.
12. [Method coefficients](methods-coefficients.html): appendix.

Batches of conditions: [Batches of conditions](guide-batches.html).
[Benchmarks](benchmarks.html) compares the integrators and the derivative
modes.

## Notation {#notation}

| symbol | meaning |
|:-------|:--------|
| $t$, $t_0$, $T$ | time, initial time, last output time |
| $x \in \mathbb{R}^{n_x}$ | state; $x_0 = x(t_0)$ |
| $p \in \mathbb{R}^{n_p}$ | parameters of the right-hand side |
| $f(x, p, t)$ | right-hand side, $\dot x = f$ |
| $J = \partial f/\partial x$ | state Jacobian |
| $\theta \in \mathbb{R}^{M}$ | parameters of the derivatives, with $x_0(\theta)$, $p(\theta)$; $\theta = (x_0, p)$, $M = n_x + n_p$ under the identity tangent |
| $\partial(x_0, p)/\partial\theta$ | tangent of the inputs, argument `tangent` of `solveODE()` |
| $S = \partial x/\partial\theta \in \mathbb{R}^{n_x \times M}$ | sensitivity matrix |
| $t_o$, $o = 1, \dots, n_{\mathrm{obs}}$ | output times, rows of the returned trajectory |
| $w \in \mathbb{R}^{n_{\mathrm{obs}} \times n_x}$ | cotangent of the outputs, row $w_o$ at $t_o$ |
| $\lambda \in \mathbb{R}^{n_x}$ | adjoint state |
| $\bar\theta$, $\bar x_0$, $\bar p$ | cotangent of the inputs, the gradient of $\sum_o w_o^{\mathsf T} x(t_o)$ |
| $t_n$, $x_n$ | step points and computed states |
| $h_n = t_{n+1} - t_n$ | step size |
| $q$, $q_{\max}$ | order, maximum order |
| $e_{n+1}$ | local error estimate of the step from $t_n$ |
| $\lVert\cdot\rVert_{\mathrm{WRMS}}$ | weighted root-mean-square norm, [Stepping (8)](methods-stepping.html#eq-wrms) |
| $W$ | iteration matrix of an implicit step, a shift of $-J$ |
| $g_e(x, t, \theta)$ | root function of an event or switch |
| $t_e(\theta)$ | firing time of a time-triggered event, an expression |
| $t^{*}$, $t_*^{(0)}$ | firing time; the value of $t^{*}$ without derivatives, the grid time |
| $\delta t^{*} = t^{*} - t_*^{(0)}$ | firing-time residual: zero in value, holds the derivatives of $t^{*}$ |
| $\dot g_e = \partial g_e/\partial t + \nabla_x g_e \cdot f$ | rate of the root function along the trajectory |
| $R(x, t)$ | reset map of an event |
| $x^{-}$, $x^{+}$; $f^{-}$, $f^{+}$ | state and right-hand side before and after an event |

Table: Symbols shared by the methods articles; others are defined where
they first appear.
